paragraphs: As our founders Larry and Sergey wrote in the original founders' letter, "Google is not a conventional company. We do not intend to become one." That unconventional spirit has been a driving force throughout our history, inspiring us to tackle big problems and invest in moonshots. It led us to be a pioneer in the development of artificial intelligence (AI) and, since 2016, be an AI-first company. We continue this work under the leadership of Alphabet and Google CEO, Sundar Pichai.

Alphabet is a collection of businesses — the largest of which is Google. We report Google in two segments, Google Services and Google Cloud, and all non-Google businesses collectively as Other Bets. Supporting these businesses, we have centralized certain AI-related research and development focused on advanced research in AI and developing the frontier models that serve our businesses, which is reported in Alphabet-level activities. Alphabet's structure is about helping each of our businesses prosper through strong leaders and independence.

The Internet is one of the world's most powerful equalizers; it propels ideas, people, and businesses large and small. Our mission to organize the world's information and make it universally accessible and useful is as relevant today as it was when we were founded in 1998. Since then, we have evolved from a company that helps people find answers to a company that also helps people get things done.

We are focused on building an even more helpful Google for everyone, and we aspire to give everyone the tools they need to increase their knowledge, health, happiness, and success. Google Search helps people find information and make sense of the world in more natural and intuitive ways, with trillions of searches on Google every year. YouTube provides people with entertainment, information, and opportunities to learn something new and helps support the creator economy through the YouTube Partner Program. Google Cloud helps customers build for the future, improve productivity, reduce costs, and unlock new growth engines. We continually innovate and build new products and features to help our users, partners, customers, and communities and have invested more than $200 billion in research and development in the last five years in support of these efforts.

We believe AI is a profound platform shift that can bring meaningful and positive change to people and societies across the world, and to our business. We aim to build the most advanced, safe, and responsible AI through our full-stack approach, which spans AI-optimized infrastructure; world-class research, including models and tooling; and our products and platforms that bring AI to billions of people, developers, and enterprises.

At the foundation of our full-stack approach is our AI-optimized infrastructure — a key differentiator enabling us to power our own products, such as Search and YouTube, and support the services we provide to our Google Cloud customers. Our technical infrastructure allows us to use and offer our customers a range of AI accelerator options, including specialized Graphics Processing Units (GPUs) and our own custom-built Tensor Processing Units (TPUs), such as Ironwood, our seventh-generation TPU. We are focused on driving efficiencies in our data centers, allowing us to leverage our technical infrastructure to deliver our products and services at an increasing scale while simultaneously enabling world-class research and model development.

Over the last decade, our research teams have pushed the boundaries of AI forward, which is displayed through Gemini 3, our most intelligent AI model yet. Designed to deliver advanced multimodal understanding, Gemini 3 represents our most capable iteration of agentic and generative coding technologies. Gemini 3 integrates enhanced reasoning capabilities to support visualizations and interactive user experiences across our product ecosystem, including Search and the Gemini app.

As technology continues to improve rapidly, we are focused on bringing our latest AI advances to our products and platforms. We continue to help our users access information and knowledge, express themselves, and get things done by embedding the power of generative AI and Gemini into our products and platforms. Today, all 15 of our half-billion-user products — including seven with two billion users — use our Gemini models. For our Google Cloud customers, our offerings are helping organizations stay at the forefront of innovation with solutions such as Gemini Enterprise and Gemini for Google Workspace.

Guided by our AI principles, we believe our approach to AI must be both bold and responsible. That means developing AI in a way that maximizes the positive benefits to society while addressing its potential challenges.

Many companies get comfortable doing what they have always done, making only incremental changes. This incrementalism leads to irrelevance over time, especially in technology, where change tends to be revolutionary, not evolutionary.

Our early investments in AI started out as moonshots but are now incorporated into our core products and central to future developments. In Other Bets, our fully autonomous driving technology company, Waymo, is now providing fully autonomous, paid ride-hailing services to customers in multiple cities. Isomorphic Labs is reimagining the drug discovery process from first principles, applying AI to accelerate the development of new medicines. We continue to look toward the future and to invest for the long term, most notably for the application of AI to our products and services, as well as other frontier technologies such as quantum computing.

We make it a priority to protect the privacy and security of our products, users, and customers, even if there are near-term financial consequences. We do this by continuously investing in building products that are secure by default; strictly upholding responsible data practices that emphasize privacy by design; and building easy-to-use settings that put people in control. We are continually enhancing these efforts over time, whether by enabling users to auto-delete their data, applying privacy technologies like on-device processing, giving people tools to control their experience, or advancing anti-malware, anti-phishing, and password security features.
For reporting purposes Google comprises two segments: Google Services and Google Cloud.

We have always been committed to building helpful products that can improve the lives of millions of people worldwide. Our product innovations are what make our services widely used, and our brand one of the most recognized in the world. Google Services' core products and platforms include ads, Android, Chrome, devices, Gmail, Google Drive, Google Gemini, Google Maps, Google Photos, Google Play, Search, and YouTube, with broad and growing adoption by users around the world.

headings: Our increasing investment in new businesses, products, services, and technologies is inherently risky, and could divert management attention and harm our business, financial condition, and operating results.
Our revenue growth rate could decline over time, and we may experience downward pressure on our operating margin in the future.
Our intellectual property rights are valuable, and any inability to protect them could reduce the value of our products, services, and brands as well as affect our ability to compete.

Our business depends on strong brands, and failing to maintain and enhance our brands would hurt our ability to expand our base of users, advertisers, customers, content providers, and other partners.
We face a number of manufacturing and supply chain risks that could affect our ability to supply our products and services and harm our business, financial condition, and operating results.
Our international operations expose us to additional risks that could harm our business, reputation, financial condition, and operating results.
Disruptions in our ability to access future financing or manage our indebtedness could adversely affect our ability to execute our strategy and harm our financial condition.
We are exposed to fluctuations in the fair values of our investments and, in some instances, our financial statements incorporate inherently subjective valuation methodologies.
Issues in the development and use of AI may result in reputational harm and increased liability exposure.
Our ongoing investments in safety, security, and content review will likely continue to identify abuse of our platforms and misuse of user data.
Risks Related to Laws, Regulations, and Policies
paragraphs: Our operations and financial results are subject to various risks and uncertainties, including but not limited to those described below, which could harm our business, reputation, financial condition, and operating results, and may affect the trading price and price volatility of our Class A and Class C stock.

We generate a significant portion of our revenues from advertising. Reduced spending by advertisers, a loss of partners, shifts in online advertising, new and evolving advertising formats, or new or existing technologies that block ads online or affect our ability to personalize ads could harm our business.

We generated more than 70% of total revenues from online advertising in 2025. Many of our advertisers, companies that distribute our products and services, digital publishers, and content providers can terminate their contracts with us at any time. These partners may not continue to do business with us if we do not create more value (such as increased numbers of users or customers, new sales leads, increased brand awareness, or more effective monetization) than their available alternatives.

We believe AI is quickly reshaping the advertising industry, including how ads are delivered online, and we and our competitors are constantly adjusting to meet this shift and provide new and evolving advertising formats. There is no assurance that we will adapt effectively and competitively to meet this shift, and that such advertising formats, strategies, and offerings will be successful.

Changes to our advertising policies and data privacy practices, as well as changes to other companies' advertising or data privacy practices have in the past, and may in the future, affect the advertising services that we are able to provide. In addition, technologies have been developed that make personalized ads more difficult, or that block the display of ads altogether, and some providers of online services have integrated technologies that could impair the availability and functionality of third-party digital advertising. Failing to provide superior value or deliver advertisements effectively and competitively could harm our business, reputation, financial condition, and operating results.

Expenditures by advertisers tend to correlate with overall economic conditions. Adverse macroeconomic conditions have affected, and may in the future affect, the demand for advertising, resulting in fluctuations in the amounts our advertisers spend on advertising, which could harm our financial condition and operating results.

paragraphs: Please read the following discussion and analysis of our financial condition and results of operations together with "Note about Forward-Looking Statements," Part I, Item 1 "Business," Part I, Item 1A "Risk Factors," and our consolidated financial statements and related notes included under Item 8 of this Annual Report on Form 10-K.

The following section generally discusses 2025 results compared to 2024 results. Discussion of 2024 results compared to 2023 results to the extent not included in this report can be found in Item 7 of our 2024 Annual Report on Form 10-K.

Alphabet is a collection of businesses — the largest of which is Google. We report Google in two segments, Google Services and Google Cloud, and all non-Google businesses collectively as Other Bets. Supporting these businesses, we have centralized certain AI-related research and development focused on advanced research in AI and developing the frontier models that serve our businesses, which is reported in Alphabet-level activities. For further details on our segments, see Part I, Item 1 Business and Note 15 of the Notes to Consolidated Financial Statements included in Item 8 of this Annual Report on Form 10-K.
The following long-term trends have contributed to the results of our consolidated operations, and we anticipate that they will continue to affect our future results:

•As we continue to grow our business and meet the evolving behaviors and needs of our users and customers, our revenue growth and mix along with our cost and margin profiles are being influenced by a number of factors, including:

Expanded AI Offerings in our Products and Services: The continuing evolution of the online world has contributed to the growth of our business. We expect that this evolution, including user engagement with AI products and services, will continue to benefit our business and our revenues. As we continue to incorporate AI into our products and services, such as with AI Overviews and AI Mode in Search, and with enterprise AI solutions on our Google Cloud Platform, we may monetize differently than our historical consumer and enterprise offerings which could affect revenue growth rates and margin trends. When developing new products and services we generally focus first on user experience and then on monetization. At the same time, we face increasing competition, including from other developers and providers of AI products and services, which may affect our revenues.

Increasing Revenues Beyond Advertising: Revenues from cloud, consumer subscriptions, platforms, and devices, which may have differing characteristics than our advertising revenues, have grown over time. Certain of these revenues have been growing at a rate higher than our advertising revenues, becoming a larger percentage of our consolidated revenues, and we expect this trend to continue. The margins on these revenues vary significantly and are generally lower than the margins on our advertising revenues.

Increased Investment in Technical Infrastructure: We continue to invest in capital expenditures as we scale our technical infrastructure, in particular for AI, to meet the demand of our users and enterprise customers and to support research internally. We invested heavily in capital expenditures in 2025 and in 2026, we expect to significantly increase, relative to 2025, our investment in our technical infrastructure, including servers and network equipment, and data centers. The costs associated with operating our technical infrastructure - depreciation, energy, equipment, and network capacity - are expected to significantly increase as developing and serving AI offerings require more compute power than our historical consumer and enterprise offerings. While our technical infrastructure costs increase, we expect to continue to drive efficiencies in our data centers, for example, through the design of our AI models and our TPU and GPU-based technical infrastructure.

Continued Investment in Intellectual Property through R&D and Acquisitions: We continue to make significant research and development investments in areas of strategic focus as we seek to develop new, innovative offerings, and improve our existing offerings across our businesses. Acquisitions and strategic investments remain important elements in our use of capital and contribute to the breadth and depth of our offerings, expand our expertise in engineering and other functional areas, and build strong partnerships around strategic initiatives.

Traffic Acquisition Costs Growth and Rate Changes: We expect traffic acquisition costs ("TAC") paid to our distribution partners and Google Network partners to increase as our advertising revenues grow. Our overall TAC as a percentage of our advertising revenues ("TAC rate") has been decreasing primarily due to a revenue mix

shift from Google Network properties to Google Search & other properties. Our TAC rate will continue to be affected by changes in device mix; geographic mix; partner agreement terms; partner mix; the percentage of queries channeled through paid access points; product mix; the relative revenue growth rates of advertising revenues from different channels; and revenue share terms.
•We have raised capital through external financing in the form of debt and we may continue to seek debt or other forms of financing in the future to support our capital and operating needs.

In 2025, we raised capital through the issuance of debt and we expect to continue to assess the use of debt and other forms of financing in the future. We expect to continue to enter into finance leases, primarily for data centers. Additionally, in 2025, we provided credit support, such as through backstops and guarantees, to certain infrastructure related counterparties and may continue to provide additional credit support in the future.

•We face an evolving regulatory environment, and we are subject to claims, lawsuits, investigations, and other forms of potential legal liability, which could affect our business practices and financial results.

headings: 為 Everyone 提供存取和技術
paragraphs: 如我們的創辦人拉里和謝爾蓋在原始創辦人信中寫道，"Google 不是一間常規公司。我們不打算成為這樣的一間公司。"這種不常規的精神一直驅使著我們的歷史，激勵我們去解決大問題並投資於夢想項目。這使我們成為人工智能（AI）開發的先驅，自2016年起，成為一家以AI為先的公司。我們在Alphabet和Google首席執行官 Sundar Pichai 的領導下繼續這項工作。

Alphabet 是一組企業——最大的是Google。我們將Google分為兩個部分，Google Services 和 Google Cloud，並將所有非Google企業合併報告為Other Bets。支持這些企業，我們集中了一些與AI相關的研究和開發，專注於AI的基礎研究和開發服務我們企業的前沿模型，這些活動在Alphabet層級活動中報告。Alphabet的結構是通過強大的領導和獨立性幫助我們的每個企業繁榮。
互聯網是世界上最強大的平權工具之一；它推動思想、人和企業，無論大小。我們組織世界資訊並使其普遍可及和有用的使命至今仍與1998年我們創立時一樣 relevant。自那以來，我們已從幫助人們尋找答案的公司演變為也幫助人們完成工作的公司。

我們專注於為所有人建立更為有用的Google，並渴望給所有人提供他們需要的工具來增加知識、健康、幸福和成功。Google Search幫助人們以更自然和直覺的方式尋找資訊並理解世界，每年在Google上進行數十億次搜尋。YouTube為人們提供娛樂、資訊和學習新事物的機會，並通過YouTube Partner Program支持創作者經濟。Google Cloud幫助客戶為未來構建、提高生產力、減少成本並打開新的增長引擎。我們不斷創新並建立新產品和功能，以幫助我們的用戶、合作夥伴、客戶和社區，並在過去五年中投資超過2000億美元於研究和開發以支持這些努力。
我們認為AI是一場深刻的平台轉移，可以為世界各地的人和社會帶來有意義和積極的變化，並對我們的業務產生影響。我們旨在通過我們的全層次方法來建立最進步、安全和負責任的AI，該方法跨越了AI優化基礎設施；世界級的研究，包括模型和工具；以及我們將AI帶給數十億人、開發者和企業的產品和平台。

我們全層次方法的基礎是我們的AI優化基礎設施——這是一個關鍵的差異因素，使我們能夠為自己的產品（如Search和YouTube）提供動力，並支持我們Google Cloud客戶提供的服務。我們的技術基礎設施使我們能夠使用和向客戶提供一系列的AI加速器選項，包括專門的圖形處理單元（GPUs）和我們自己定製的Tensor Processing Units（TPUs），如Ironwood，我們的第七代TPU。我們專注於提高資料中心的效率，使我們能夠利用我們的技術基礎設施以日益擴大的規模交付產品和服務，同時同時啟用世界級的研究和模型開發。
過去十年來，我們的研究小組推動了AI的邊界向前，這通過Gemini 3，我們迄今為止最智能的AI模型來顯示。Gemini 3設計用於交付進階的多模態理解，代表了我們最強大的迭代的機器人和生成式編碼技術。Gemini 3整合了增強的推理能力，以支持我們產品生態系統中的視覺化和互動用戶體驗，包括Search和Gemini應用程序。

隨著技術不斷迅速改進，我們專注於將我們最新的AI進步帶到我們的產品和平台上。我們繼續幫助用戶訪問資訊和知識，表達自己，並完成工作，通過將生成式AI和Gemini嵌入到我們的產品和平台上。今天，我們的15個半億用戶產品中，包括七個有兩億用戶的產品，都使用我們的Gemini模型。對於我們的Google Cloud客戶，我們的產品幫助組織保持在創新前沿，例如Gemini Enterprise和Gemini for Google Workspace的解決方案。
基於我們的人工智慧原則，我們認為我們的人工智慧方法必須既果斷又負責任。這意味著以一種方式開發人工智慧，以最大化對社會的正面影響，同時處理其潛在挑戰。
許多公司習慣於做他們一直做的事情，只做微小的改變。這種微小的改變會隨著時間變得無關緊要，特別是在技術領域，變化往往會是革命性的，而不是演進性的。
我們早期在人工智慧方面的投資最初是夢想成真，但現在已經融入我們的核心產品中，成為未來發展的關鍵。在其他投資方面，我們全自動駕駛技術公司Waymo現在正在多個城市為客戶提供全自動付費的打車服務。Isomorphic Labs正在從第一原理重新想像藥物發現過程，應用人工智慧加速新藥的開發。我們繼續展望未來，長期投資，特別是將人工智慧應用於我們的產品和服務，以及其他前沿技術，如量子計算。
我們將保護我們的產品、用戶和客戶的隱私和安全視為優先事項，即使會有短期的財務後果。我們通過不斷投資於默認安全的產品、嚴格執行注重隱私設計的責任數據實踐，以及建立讓人們自己掌控的易用設置來實現這一點。我們會隨著時間不斷增強這些努力，無論是通過讓用戶自動刪除數據、應用設備端處理等隱私技術、給人們工具來控制自己的體驗，還是推進反病毒、反詐騙和密碼安全功能。
為報告目的，Google由兩個分部組成：Google Services和Google Cloud。

我們一直致力於建立有助於改善全球數百萬人生活的產品。我們的產品創新使我們的服務廣泛使用，我們的品牌是全球最 recognizable 的品牌之一。Google Services的核心產品和平台包括廣告、Android、Chrome、設備、Gmail、Google Drive、Google Gemini、Google Maps、Google Photos、Google Play、搜索和YouTube，這些產品和平台在全球用戶中得到了廣泛和不斷增長的採用。

paragraphs: 請閱讀我們的財務狀況和營運結果的以下討論和分析，以及「關於前瞻性陳述的說明」、第一部分第一項「事業」、第一部分第一項A「風險因素」，以及本年度報告表10-K第8項所包含的合併財務報表和相關附註。
本節一般性地討論了2025年的結果與2024年的結果相比。關於2024年的結果與2023年的結果的討論，如本報告未包括，請見我們2024年度報告表10-K第7項。

Alphabet是一組企業——其中最大的是Google。我們將Google分為Google Services和Google Cloud兩個部分，並將所有非Google企業合併報告為Other Bets。為了支持這些企業，我們集中了一些與AI相關的研究和開發，專注於AI的進階研究和開發為我們企業服務的邊緣模型，這些活動在Alphabet層級活動中報告。關於我們各個部分的詳細情況，請見本年度報告表10-K第8項所包含的合併財務報表附註第15項。
以下長期趨勢促成了我們合併營運結果，我們預期這些趨勢將繼續影響我們的未來結果：
•隨著我們繼續增長事業並滿足用戶和客戶不斷演變的行為和需求，我們的營收增長和結構以及成本和利潤配置受到多個因素的影響，包括：

我們產品和服務中的擴大AI供應：隨著線上世界的持續演化，我們的事業增長。我們預期這種演進，包括用戶與AI產品和服務的互動，將繼續利於我們的事業和營收。隨著我們繼續將AI整合到我們的產品和服務中，例如AI總覽和Search中的AI模式，以及我們Google雲平台上的企業AI解決方案，我們可能會以不同的方式營收，這可能會影響營收增長率和利潤趨勢。在開發新產品和服務時，我們通常首先關注用戶體驗，然後再關注營收。同時，我們面臨著越來越激烈的競爭，包括其他開發者和AI產品和服務提供商，這可能會影響我們的營收。
超越廣告的收入增長：隨著雲端、消費者訂閱、平台和設備的收入增長，這些收入可能具有與我們廣告收入不同的特點。隨著時間的推移，這些收入已經增長，某些收入增長率高於我們的廣告收入，成為我們合併收入的更大比例，我們預期這種趨勢將繼續。這些收入的利潤率有很大不同，通常低於我們廣告收入的利潤率。

增加技術基礎設施的投資：我們繼續在技術基礎設施上進行資本支出，以應對我們用戶和企業客戶的需求，並支持我們的內部研究。我們在2025年和2026年投資了大量資本支出，預期相對於2025年，我們在技術基礎設施上的投資，包括伺服器和網路設備，以及資料中心，將顯著增加。運行我們技術基礎設施的成本——折舊、能源、設備和網路容量——預期將隨著開發和服務AI供應需要更多的計算能力而顯著增加。雖然我們技術基礎設施的成本增加，我們預期將繼續通過設計我們的AI模型和基於TPU和GPU的技術基礎設施來提高資料中心的效率。
本公司繼續通過研發和收購投資智慧財產權：我們繼續在戰略重點領域進行重大研發投資，以開發新的創新產品和改進我們企業的現有產品。收購和戰略投資仍然是我們使用資金的重要元素，並有助於擴展我們產品的範圍和深度，增強我們在工程及其他功能領域的專業知識，並圍繞戰略項目建立強大的合作夥伴關係。

交通獲取成本增長及速率變動：我們預期隨著廣告收入的增長，本公司向分銷夥伴和Google網路夥伴支付的交通獲取成本（"TAC"）將會增加。我們整體的TAC佔廣告收入的比例（"TAC速率"）主要由於廣告收入組合從Google網路屬性轉移到Google搜索及其他屬性而下降。我們的TAC速率將繼續受到設備組合、地理組合、夥伴協議條款、夥伴組合、通過付費接入點導入查詢的百分比、產品組合、不同渠道廣告收入相對增長率以及收入分成條款的變動影響。

•本公司通過借貸融資方式籌集資金，並將可能繼續尋求借貸或其他形式的融資，以支持本公司資本和營運需求。
在2025年，本公司通過發行借貸籌集資金，並預期將繼續評估未來借貸及其他形式融資的使用。本公司預期將繼續進入資料中心的融資lease，此外，在2025年，本公司向某些基礎設施相關的對手方提供信貸支持，如通過後盾和保証，並可能繼續提供additional的信貸支持。
•本公司面臨著不斷演變的監管環境，並受到claims、訴訟、調查及其他形式潛在法律責任的影響，這可能會影響本公司業務實踐和財務結果。

headings: 本公司在新事業、產品、服務及技術方面的投資日益增加，固有風險高，可能會分散管理注意力，損害本公司業務、財務狀況及營運結果。
本公司營收增長率可能會隨著時間下降，未來可能會對本公司營運毛利產生下行壓力。
本公司智慧財產權具有價值，若無法保護，可能會降低本公司產品、服務及品牌之價值，並影響本公司競爭能力。
本公司依賴強大的品牌，若未能維持及提升本公司品牌，可能會損害本公司擴大用戶基礎、廣告商、客戶、內容供應商及其他夥伴之能力。
本公司面臨多種製造及供應鏈風險，可能會影響本公司供應產品及服務的能力，損害本公司業務、財務狀況及營運結果。
本公司國際業務使本公司曝露於更多風險，可能會損害本公司業務、聲譽、財務狀況及營運結果。
我們的未來融資能力或債務管理能力的幹擾可能會影響我們執行策略的能力，並損害我們的財務狀況。
我們受到我們投資的公平價值波動的影響，而在某些情況下，我們的財務報表可能包含固有主觀的估值方法。
與我們行業相關的風險
人工智能的開發和使用問題可能會導致聲譽損失和責任暴露增加。
我們在安全、安全和內容審查方面的持續投資可能會繼續識別我們平台的濫用和用戶數據的濫用。
與法律、規範和政策相關的風險
paragraphs: 本公司之營運及財務結果受多種風險及不確定性影響，包括但不限於以下所述者，這些風險及不確定性可能會損害本公司之業務、聲譽、財務狀況及營運結果，並可能影響本公司A類及C類股之交易價格及波動性。
本公司之大部分營收來自廣告。廣告主減少支出、合作夥伴流失、線上廣告轉移、新及演進中的廣告格式、或新或現有技術阻擋線上廣告或影響本公司廣告個人化能力，可能會損害本公司之業務。
本公司於2025年從線上廣告產生超過70%之總營收。本公司之許多廣告主、產品及服務之發行公司、數位出版商及內容提供商可隨時終止與本公司之合約。若本公司未能創造更多價值（如用戶或客戶數量增加、新銷售機會、品牌意識提升或更有效的營收模式），這些合作夥伴可能會停止與本公司合作。
本公司認為人工智能正在迅速重塑廣告行業，包括廣告在線交付方式，本公司及競爭對手不斷調整以應對此轉變並提供新及演進中的廣告格式。並無保障本公司能夠有效及競爭力地應對此轉變，且此廣告格式、策略及供應將會成功。
本公司廣告政策及數據隱私實踐之變更，以及其他公司廣告或數據隱私實踐之變更，過去及未來可能會影響本公司能夠提供的廣告服務。此外，已開發出技術使個人化廣告更難，或完全阻擋廣告顯示，且一些線上服務提供商已整合技術可能會影響第三方數位廣告之可用性及功能。未能提供優秀價值或有效及競爭力地交付廣告可能會損害本公司之業務、聲譽、財務狀況及營運結果。
廣告主之支出通常與總體經濟環境相關。不利之總體經濟環境已影響，且可能會繼續影響廣告需求，導致廣告主在廣告上支出之數額波動，這可能會損害本公司之財務狀況及營運結果。
